mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS shows a sustained upward trend (defined as 3 consecutive monthly increases).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and INDPRO growth is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in predicting SPX 20-day returns over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 8.5%), a monthly growth rate in industrial production above 1.0% indicates strong manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% and UNRATE is below 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL shows a sustained upward trend (3 consecutive monthly increases).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through higher consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS growth is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in predicting SPX 60-day returns over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2.0%), a monthly housing start rate above 600.0 thousand units signals strong housing market activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0 and CPIAUCSL annualized growth is below 2.0%.
